title: Seconds to a clock
description:
Read a whole number of seconds and print it as hours, minutes and seconds, `H:MM:SS`. Minutes and seconds always have two digits; hours have as many as they need.

```
Seconds? 3725
1:02:05
```

The prompt is `Seconds? ` with a space after the question mark, written with `io.write` so the answer stays on the same line.

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Seconds? ")
local total = io.read("n")
local hours = total // 3600
local minutes = total % 3600 // 60
local seconds = total % 60
print(string.format("%d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds))

hints: `//` divides and rounds down; `%` gives what is left over. There are 3600 seconds in an hour.
`string.format("%02d", 5)` gives `05`: at least two digits, padded with a zero.
